bio.text: Tony Guy is the Republican nominee for Pennsylvania's 17th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
According to his campaign website, he is Beaver County sheriff, a post to which he was elected in 2016, and a lifelong Beaver County resident.
The campaign site says he served 26 years with the Pennsylvania State Police before becoming sheriff.
